Reviewer (member_002) ready for independent review.

I independently inspected sympy/functions/elementary/hyperbolic.py coth.eval. In the arg.is_Add branch:
  x, m = _peeloff_ipi(arg)
  if m:
      cothm = coth(m)
      if cotm is S.ComplexInfinity:   # NameError: cothm intended
          return coth(x)
      else:  # cothm == 0
          return tanh(x)
So the crash is a typo (`cotm` vs `cothm`). Note also the returns must be consistent: coth(x + m*I*pi) = coth(x) and coth(x + I*pi/2) = tanh(x). Verify that the (cothm is S.ComplexInfinity) branch corresponds to m=I*pi/2 (→ tanh(x)) and cothm==0 corresponds to m=I*pi (→ coth(x)); the original code has them swapped relative to those comments, so a pure name fix may return the wrong branch. Please double-check that and add a regression test for coth(log(tan(2))) etc.

When ready, publish the exact final candidate with fix_patch and send handoff_patch to member_002. I will integrate_patch, run_tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch.

Please adopt, run public tests and independently review this final candidate (patch-1, source version v3).

What changed:
1. sympy/functions/elementary/hyperbolic.py, coth.eval, arg.is_Add branch: `if cotm is S.ComplexInfinity:` -> `if cothm is S.ComplexInfinity:`. This is the NameError you independently identified. It triggered whenever _peeloff_ipi(arg) returned a nonzero I*pi multiple, which is why coth(log(tan(x))).subs(x, N) crashed for N like 2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12 (log(tan(N)) is an Add with a pure-imaginary part).
2. sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py, test_coth: added regression assertions `coth(x + 2*I*pi) == coth(x)` and a loop asserting `coth(log(tan(S(n)))).subs(x, n) == coth(log(tan(S(n))))` for n in (2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12).

Expected semantics I verified by inspection: coth(m) with m = k*I*pi gives ComplexInfinity (returning coth(x)), and m = I*pi/2 gives 0 (returning tanh(x)), consistent with your note.

My same-version public evidence: sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py -> 45 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (report test-report-e12d356186566a5103b0d800, source version v3, files_sha256 0998d9e0...). Please run your own public tests on the adopted exact version and then org_review_patch accept or request changes.

Review complete: ACCEPTED (patch-1, review-1).

My independent evidence:
- Adopted patch-1 into my own tree via integrate_patch; 0 conflicts, resulting source version v2, files_sha256 0998d9e0...
- Ran public tests on that exact adopted version: sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py -> 45 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, validation_status verified (report test-report-995d86b0114f6bd1d1b41cde, source v2).

I did not accept on test outcome alone. I verified the branch semantics from source: _peeloff_ipi returns m as a multiple of I*pi/2, so with the `cotm`->`cothm` fix, m = I*pi/2 gives cothm == 0 -> tanh(x) (matches coth(x+I*pi/2)=tanh(x)) and m = I*pi gives cothm is ComplexInfinity -> coth(x) (matches coth(x+I*pi)=coth(x)). This also matches the existing tanh.eval idiom at line 446. The risk I flagged earlier — that a pure name fix could return the wrong branch — does not materialize.

Reminder per protocol: acceptance does not merge into your tree. You still own the delivery steps: integrate_patch(patch-1) in your own workspace, run_tests on that exact final version, fix_patch(task_ids=...) if your tree differs, then submit_integration. I did not edit your version and made no changes of my own beyond adopting patch-1 for review.
